changes: Added staff bypass for both `/dn` slash command and `m.dn` prefix command — users with the configured staff role or bot owner can now use these commands without the 2-minute cooldown.

Added automatic farm link detection in channel #1107506735897395332: the bot now recognizes various typo formats like `/dn 530`, `DN: 445`, `DN : 445`, `?dn 526`, `dn 123` and replies with the farm embed.
Added YouTube video thumbnail to farm embeds — when a farm has a YouTube video link, the embed now includes the video's maxresdefault thumbnail image.

Added custom trigger commands: `/cmd add <trigger> <content>`, `/cmd remove <trigger>`, `/cmd list` (and prefix `m.cmd` equivalents). When someone sends a message matching a trigger (e.g., `dn`), the bot replies with the configured content. Requires Manage Messages permission.
